messages:
neil: Quick follow-up on the on-prem/airgap RFC — I'd like to propose a migration playbook + a small compat shim rather than forcing full-image swaps for everyone. Thoughts?

yasmin: +1. We get a lot of noisy 'upgrade failed' tickets. A staged operator flow that can prepare without activating would help a lot.

raj: runtime note: any plan that forces a cold restart for large modelstores will break SLOs. We need a lazy-load path for model shards and an in-place KV layout migration that can run post-activate.

neil: Sketch of the playbook idea:
- bundle contains: new runtime image, compat-shim binary, signed manifest (v2)
- operator PREPARE: unpack, verify signatures, stage shim and images (no swap)
- operator ACTIVATE (canary first): swap activation marker, start shim in proxy mode -> runtime; run background migration; watch health
- operator CLEANUP: after X days and successful canary, garbage collect old artifacts
rollback: keep last-known-good image + marker for 7 days to allow automatic fallback

yasmin: operator API suggestion: expose phases as discrete states PREPARE/ACTIVATE/CLEANUP and metrics like `operator.upgrades.phase` and `operator.upgrades.progress_percent`. Also add an `activation-safety-window` TTL to prevent immediate GC.

neil: Example manifest snippet we discussed: ```json
{
  "bundle": "redwood-onprem-2026-06",
  "images": ["runtime:v3.4.1","shim:v0.2.0"],
  "signatures": ["sha256:..."],
  "activation_marker": "marker.v3",
  "kv_layout_version": 5
}
```

raj: For KV layout version bumps we should not block activation. Propose a flag: `--migrate-kv=background` that spawns a low-priority migrator thread which reports progress via runtime metrics and accepts hedged reads. That avoids long downtime.

tanya: Security constraints: we cannot accept unsigned transitional artifacts. Suggest a signer-rotation flow: operator announces rotation window, offline signer rotates keys, new attestations included in the manifest. Also include an attestation token envelope so onprem operators can validate rotation chain offline.

neil: Agree. Also thinking about compatibility shim responsibilities:
- proxy API compatibility for older operator RPCs
- temporary translation layer for manifest fields (v1 -> v2)
- healthcheck endpoint that reports both shim+runtime health for canaries

yasmin: Implementation note: PREPARE should create a `staged/` directory on disk with deterministic layout so audits are possible. Metric to track: `operator.upgrades.staged_size_bytes`.

operator-bot: deploy-bot: canary roll for `eng-cluster-3` started, will post status here. :rocket:

raj: One more runtime edge: model shard encryption keys may be rotated in this flow. We need to support a two-phase key rewrap where old keys can still decrypt until assets are rewrapped in background. Add `--allow-key-rewrap=true` and a `rewrap-progress` metric.

tanya: I'll draft the signing runbook + offline rotation checklist and link it to the RFC follow-up. We need operator UX for 'verify-only' mode so customers can dry-run.

neil: Action items: yasmin -> operator API + metrics changes; raj -> runtime CLI + background migration spec; tanya -> signing/attestation runbook; neil -> RFC follow-up draft with playbook and sample manifests. Target: draft ready by EOD next Thursday.

yasmin: noted and created INFRA-3421 to track operator work, PR draft at https://git.internal/repos/redwood/operator/pulls/87 :+1:

raj: ack, will open runtime spec PR by EOW.

operator-bot: deploy-bot: canary on `eng-cluster-3` succeeded, health metrics look stable. :white_check_mark:

neil: Nice. We'll fold canary notes into the RFC. Thanks all. :clap:
